summary: Frontend-only test of /app/demo-game (desktop 1920 + mobile 390) as demo@aetheria.io. Verified: disclaimer, 3 tabs, $1,000 start balance; Rivals table (3 multi-side rounds, net + balance math exact for side wins, history dots, Clear bets, insufficient-balance toast, Reset to $1,000); Andar Bahar (4 rounds, joker shown, alternating Andar-first deal, winner computed correctly, Andar win net = 1.9x stake, Bahar loss/win math correct, bet spots disabled while dealing, winner bet spot highlighted); 'Ready for real play?' dialog appears exactly once after 5th round across both tables (and with 5 Rivals rounds on mobile), Keep practicing closes it, Go to Deposits navigates to /app/deposits; sound toggle flips aria/icon and persists localStorage scarmenta_demo_sound off/on across reload; no Web Audio console errors / page errors; tutorial shows 2 guides x 3 steps; real wallet balance unchanged (1039.0 before & after); mobile has no horizontal overflow. Found 1 logic bug (wrong winning card highlighted in Andar Bahar) and 1 mobile layout issue (latest AB cards clipped). Tie payout path not hit randomly; verified by code review only.

ui_bugs.issue: The green ring that marks the winning card goes on the wrong card. It lands on the second-to-last card dealt, which sits on the losing side, not on the card that matched the Joker. Seen in every round: Joker 8, winner 8♠ on Andar, but the ring was on 10♣ on Bahar. Joker J, winner J♥, ring on 5♣. Root cause: `setDealt((d) => [...d, { ...c, hit: i === round.seq.length - 1 }])` reads `i` inside the updater function. React 18 runs that function later, after `i += 1` has already happened. Fix: work out `const isHit = i === round.seq.length - 1` before calling setDealt, or use the index of the card in the seq.

Each row shows the last 8 cards (`cards.slice(-8)`) in an overflow-hidden flex box. At 390px only about 4.5 cards fit, so the newest cards, including the winning card, are cut off on the right and can't be seen. Fix: show fewer cards on small screens, use overflow-x-auto, or reverse the order so the newest card is on the left.

issues: The 'Not enough demo balance' toast sits on top of the bottom-right chat widget button.

action_items: Fix the Andar Bahar winning-card ring: compute the hit flag before setDealt instead of reading the mutable `i` inside the updater.
Make the Andar Bahar rows show the newest/winning card on mobile (390px).
critical_code_review_comments: DemoGame Reset doesn't clear bets that are already placed. If the balance is above $1,000 and more than $1,000 is staked, pressing Reset can let the balance go negative on a loss. Pressing Reset during a deal also sets the balance to $1,000 and then the round's net is added on top. Consider disabling Reset while dealing, or clearing bets on Reset.

Radix TabsContent unmounts the inactive tab. Switching tabs during an Andar Bahar deal clears the interval, so the round never settles and never counts toward the 5-round prompt. Rivals keeps its setTimeout running and calls onRound after unmount. Harmless for a demo, but the two tables behave differently. Consider forceMount, or disabling the tabs while dealing.

DemoGame onRound calls setPrompt inside the setRounds updater. That is a side effect inside an updater, which StrictMode runs twice. It works because the call is idempotent, but it's better to check the count in a useEffect.
